description:
FOUND + FIXED s420, while implementing #412 (the two live in the same runtime
function, set-match-vars).

perl sizes the two magic offset arrays DIFFERENTLY, and t/re/pat.t asserts it:

    "ab" =~ /(a)(x)?(y)?/;   perl: $#+ = 3, $#- = 1
    "ab" =~ /(a)(b)/;        perl: $#+ = 2, $#- = 2

$#+ is "the number of capture groups in the last successful match" — the
PATTERN's group count, with a present undef for a group that did not
participate — while $#- stops after the last group that DID participate.
PCL truncated BOTH at the last participating group, so $#+ (and scalar @+)
under-reported whenever a trailing group was optional and missed.

Fixed: two loops instead of one in set-match-vars.  Four shapes probed
identical to perl.  Guard: Pl/t/match-vars-01.t row 27.
title: @+ is sized by the pattern, @- by participation — $#+ was wrong
